text.en:
The merger of CDC and CIAC is hereby authorized subject
to the provisions of the Corporation Code.

The Chairman of the BCD is directed to prepare a plan and take
all the necessary steps towards effecting the merger of CDC and CIAC, with CDC
as the surviving corporation.

The BCDA Chairman shall submit a report to the President on the
action taken as soon as the merger shall have been completed.

All orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 26th day of March, in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and One.
By the President:
RENATO S. DE VILLA
Executive Secretary
